title: Scope M3.3 exact-head validation to its governed pull-request head
purpose: Prevent the historical M3.3 exact-head product validator from producing false failures on unrelated pull requests that touch shared factory documentation, while preserving its governed pull-request head and all push/workflow_dispatch behavior.
invariants: Only the M3.3 workflow routing guard and CI-WP-011 metadata change.
On pull_request, M3.3 exact-head validation executes only for atlas/ATLAS-WP-019-m3-3-review-handoff.
All M3.3 validation steps below the job guard remain byte-for-byte unchanged.
No product/runtime/contract semantics or branch-protection behavior changes.
requiredEvidence: CI-WP-011 pull request shows M3.3 exact-head validation skipped rather than failed.
Static guard contains exactly the governed historical M3.3 head ref.
Static proof that job steps remain unchanged from baseline.
adversarialTests: The unrelated M3.4 product pull-request head must not execute the M3.3 branch assertion.
An unknown pull-request head must not execute the M3.3 exact-head job.
The governed M3.3 head must still satisfy the guard.
A push event must still satisfy the guard regardless of head_ref.
A workflow_dispatch event must still satisfy the guard regardless of head_ref.
independentReview: Repository governance and PR scope gate this two-file CI-only change.
The exact CI pull request must demonstrate neutral skip behavior for the historical M3.3 validator.
rollback: Remove the job-level pull-request head guard and CI-WP-011 metadata; historical false-failure behavior returns.
